notes: Introduced a premium UI overhaul with a dynamic animated Splash Screen, a luxurious full-screen Dashboard background, custom overscroll branding animations, and improved Quick Actions routing. Added a 'New Order' Floating Action Button (FAB) for seamless POS entry. Integrated a secure POS QR Code & Link sharing feature for manual orders, including automatic status syncing, intelligent 10-minute expiry timers, and automatic Stripe webhook refunds for late payments. Additionally, completely redesigned the Login and Forgot Password screens with centered, industry-level aesthetics and brand icons. Added premium confirmation dialogs for order actions (Cancel, Refund, Remake) and introduced a 'Track Live Order' button directly on Live Order cards. Resolved Android 12+ adaptive splash icon cutoff issues, fixed Dashboard layout overflow bugs for better responsiveness, and resolved critical R8/ProGuard release build crashes related to the Stripe SDK, Created New Customers & CRM Screen.
